text:
Ruth: Quick QA note from the dashboard pass: icon-only buttons in table rows are collapsing when we switch the icon to a loading spinner. The spinner shrinks and the row content jumps. Figma: https://figma.com/file/icon-loading-jump
Evan: Yeah that's because we swap the SVG for a smaller spinner element. We should reserve the same width/height for the loading state to avoid layout shift. Either use an overlay spinner or keep an invisible placeholder element.
Priya: Accessibility: icon-only buttons must have a visible focus ring and an accessible name (aria-label). When we swap to loading, make sure the aria-label reflects the loading state (e.g., "Saving...") and announce via live region if it's long running.
Marco: Motion note: use prefers-reduced-motion for spinner animation. For small bandwidth devices the spinner should be minimal. Also avoid animating height/padding when toggling states.
Ruth: Suggested CSS pattern:
```
.button-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.button-icon .icon, .button-icon .placeholder { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
```
Keep `.placeholder` when spinner shows so layout stays fixed.
Evan: Also consider minimum touch target: update tokens so `button.minSize` = 40px on touch breakpoints. Right now compact tokens set it to 32 which fails 44px guidance. Let's keep desktop compact at 32 but mobile at 44.
Priya: Copy nit: when an action is destructive + loading ("Delete..."), make the loading label explicit for screen readers and announce completion in a toast: "Item deleted" via role/status. Don't use `aria-busy` alone as it can be noisy.
Marco: For the component API: add props `loadingLabel` and `keepSizeOnLoad: boolean` (default true) so implementers opt in for no-shift behavior. Also expose `reducedMotion` flag to switch spinner to a static icon.
Ruth: Figma updates: I'll add a variant that shows overlay spinner and a variant that keeps placeholder. I'll also add notes about focus ring not being clipped when cell padding is reduced by `spacing.density.compact-2` tokens.
Evan: Token suggestion: rename `spacing.compact-*` to `spacing.density.compact-*` and add `button.minSize.touch=44px` and `button.minSize.desktopCompact=32px` to token docs.
Priya: Quick keyboard behavior check: when button goes to loading, do not move focus. Keep focus on the button and set `aria-live="polite"` for long ops if you want to announce status.
Marco: I'll open a small PR to change the spinner to an absolutely positioned overlay within the button so icon stays in DOM and we avoid reflow. ETA tomorrow EOD.
design-bot: preview updated: https://deploy.preview/button-loading-ux (shows overlay + tokens) :rocket:
Ruth: Thanks! I'll run a quick a11y pass after the PR lands and post any VoiceOver/NVDA notes. :white_check_mark:
